cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Phione
cards.description: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.description: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.description: Its fur has the look and feel of velvet. The orb on its forehead glows when it uses psycho-power.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.description: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.description: Its huge mouth is almost seven feet across. It has enough power to completely crush a car.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.description: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: It controls 10,000-volt power and can raise all the furs on its body as if it were sharp needles.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.description: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.description: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

cards.name: Phione
cards.description: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.description: Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of water have been mistaken for "moving forests."

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: The light of the moon changed Eevee's genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.

cards.name: Unown P
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: It has evolved to be suitable for aquatic life. It can invisibly melt away into water.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.description: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.description: The shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.description: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.description: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: Its wings deliver wicked blows that snap even the thickest of trees. It searches for prey in icy seas.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja's.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.description: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: It stands along paths pretending to be a tree. If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.

cards.name: Unown Q
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.description: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: It lives atop giant trees. It wraps its tail around a branch so it won't fall off while asleep.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: X-ray photos were taken to check its body structure. Nothing appeared, however.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

cards.name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
cards.description: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

cards.name: Chingling
cards.description: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.description: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: It tugs on the hands of children to steal them away. However, it gets pulled around instead.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.description: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.description: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.description: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

cards.name: Munchlax
cards.description: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.description: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.description: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

cards.name: Shellos East Sea
cards.description: It lives along bodies of water. Its body shape changed to suit its habitat.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

cards.name: Starly
cards.description: Usually with a large flock, it is barely noticeable when alone. Its cries are very strident.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.description: It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.
